342.s: When he had finished unpacking, he laid a faded strip of brightly coloured cotton on the bed, in company with a soiled jacket and a tattered silk headscarf, and, as Shiraz made these preparations, Coryndon, with the aid of a few pigments in a tin box, altered his face beyond recognition.
